entries.subject: LAM/SPHERE MPCD: selected reconstruction
entries.finding: The current LAM 3Dshape directory lists 704_Interamnia_mpcd.obj, matching the actual preparation input. The retained measurements describe 6514 vertices and 13024 facets in km; the recipe preserves that source scale. This review checked the release listing and local source/recipe binding, not a fresh mesh reconstruction or new source-fit test.

entries.subject: Size and pole
entries.finding: The retained Table 1 and Table A.1 extract records diameter 332 km, ecliptic J2000 pole (87°, 62°), period 8.71234 h. Published survey diameter averages ADAM and MPCD; the released MPCD coordinates are not rescaled to that average. The measured source volume-equivalent radius is 166.1079850227006 km. These source interpretations were checked against the recipe; the paper table was not freshly re-transcribed in this pass.

entries.subject: Released SPHERE observations and surface registration
entries.finding: The live source folder https://observations.lam.fr/astero/Data/704Interamnia/ contains Deconv/ and Red/. Reduced and deconvolved observations therefore have a concrete archive route. Their pixels, image geometry, coverage and photometry were not qualified in this directory-level check, so these files cannot yet be treated as a registered global reflectance map. The current grid remains an explicit missing-imagery presentation.
entries.revisitWhen: The original image headers and publication establish a usable projection onto this specific MPCD model, and a native-pixel comparison qualifies geometry, illumination and measured coverage.

entries.subject: Released ADAM companion model
entries.finding: The live directory also lists 704_Interamnia_adam.obj. The body’s retained model comparison already distinguishes this ADAM reconstruction from the selected MPCD mesh. It is not adopted as a duplicate view of the same measured shape; the original comparison remains linked.
entries.revisitWhen: An observation or scientific comparison specifically requires this alternative mesh and its matching source frame.
